item.title: Oracle Offers New Capabilities in Supply Chain and Manufacturing
item.description: Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain and Manufacturing has newly added features that support mixed-mode manufacturing strategies.

item.title: FAO Releases Report on Fish Fraud
item.description: “Food fraud in the fisheries and aquaculture sector” was produced by FAO through cooperation between its Fisheries and Aquaculture Division and the Joint FAO/International Atomic Energy Agency Centre of Nuclear Techniques in Food and Agriculture.

item.title: Key Technology Introduces New ADR X for Potato Strips
item.description: The new ADR X features enhanced multi-spectral sensing, an updated mechanical architecture and more to identify defects on wet potato strips and trim only the affected areas so more usable product can be recovered.

item.title: Puratos Acquires Pennsylvania-Based Vör Foods
item.description: Located just 35 minutes from Puratos’ U.S. headquarters, the Trevose, Pa., facility will support closer technical collaboration and the exchange of best practices between the teams.

item.title: SafetyChain Receives SOC 2 Type 2 Certification
item.description: The independent audit, conducted by Sensiba LLP, assessed both the design and operating effectiveness of SafetyChain’s internal controls over a six-month review period from May through October 2025.

item.title: bioMérieux Launches New Platform for Spoiler Risk Management
item.description: SMARTBIOME is designed to help food manufacturers better understand, control and prevent microbiological spoilage.

item.title: TraceGains and iFoodDS Extend Strategic Alliance
item.description: The expanded alliance aims to deliver seamless data integration that simplifies how suppliers share traceability data and how food and beverage companies identify, monitor and work with FSMA 204-ready trading partners.

item.title: FDA Releases New Traceability Rule Guidance
item.description: The agency issued a Q&A addressing stakeholder questions on the implementation of the Food Traceability Rule, as well as a notice exempting certain cottage cheese products from the requirements of the rule.

item.title: USDA Proposes Increasing Poultry, Pork Line Speeds
item.description: The agency’s proposals would raise line speeds to up to 175 birds per minute for young chickens and up to 60 birds per minute for turkeys, plus eliminate the maximum line speed limit of 1,106 head per hour at pork establishments.

item.title: FDA Releases Produce Regulatory Program Standards
item.description: The Produce Regulatory Program Standards provide a uniform foundation across government produce regulators to advance an integrated food safety system that leverages collaboration and resources among federal, state, local and tribal agencies to protect public health, said the agency.
